$comment: The demo directory — name + title + tagline per demo. This is NOT a runtime registry: each demo is self-contained (demos/<name>/frontend + demos/<name>/backend), the backend discovers routers by scanning demos/*/backend, and each frontend declares only its connection wiring (tenant + agent id + publishable key) — voice and language belong to the brain, never to the page. This file is shipped inside the built web artifact so the marketing site can render the /demos index (the gallery) and weave the demos into its story without hardcoding the list. Adding a demo: scaffold demos/<name>/ (see demos/README.md), then add an entry here so it shows on the /demos index.
